name: Slant

sources.title: Slant's own comparison page — 'not financially tied to any products'; questions/options/pros-cons added and edited by users; community can flag/edit false claims (content read via search result; site 403 to fetchers)
Third-party guide — add your product as an option on relevant 'What is the best X?' questions; account required, no backlink, instant community approval (content read via search result)

requirements: Products appear as 'options' under community questions ('What is the best X?') — add your product as an option on relevant existing questions, or create a new question
Options need pros/cons written by the community — thin or fake pros/cons get flagged and edited out
No payment path to placement — Slant states it isn't financially tied to listed products and paid 'favorable reviews' don't exist
slant.co blocked automated fetch (403) — verified via Slant's own content and third-party guides
preparation: List the questions where your product is a legitimate answer (e.g., 'What is the best X for Y?')
Honest pros/cons — the community edits false claims
Account credibility: contribute to unrelated questions before adding your own product
workflow: Find relevant 'What is the best…' questions and add your product as an option with genuine pros/cons
Build credibility by contributing to other questions first — fresh accounts self-promoting get flagged
watchFor: Self-promotion is policed by the community — false pros/cons get edited or flagged; astroturfing damages the listing
Outbound links are nofollow (per third-party guides) — audience play, not link equity
Answers must fit an existing question — a product nobody asks about won't surface
Site health appeared degraded in this session (403 to fetchers); community activity level uncertain
countsAsLive: The product appears as an option on one or more Slant question pages
unknowns: Whether the site still actively maintains the platform
